question: Can the clean H0 topological direction autonomously distinguish the entry into and exit from a physically reentrant lobe?

observable.inner_product: trapezoidal L2 integral over filtration coordinate after summing landscape layers, divided by the fixed layer count
observable.derivative: forward finite difference assigned to Gamma midpoints

template.training: older clean OBC L16 and L64 directed cuts; no random or reentrant data

frozen_detection_rule.search_domain: all derivative intervals except the first interval touching Gamma0=0
frozen_detection_rule.entry: global minimum of v_parallel; it must be negative
frozen_detection_rule.exit: global maximum of v_parallel; it must be positive
frozen_detection_rule.ordered_reentrance: entry_Gamma < exit_Gamma and both sign conditions pass
frozen_detection_rule.qc_policy: retain and report branch-disagreement and bond-saturation flags; do not exclude them

primary_evaluation.localization: physically selected seeds, with physical entry and exit revealed only after topological predictions
primary_evaluation.unconditional_control: apply the identical signed rule to every seed and report the ordered-pair rate among physical positives and controls
primary_evaluation.aggregate: apply the same extrema rule to the arithmetic mean signed velocity; linearity makes mean velocities equal velocity of the mean landscape

comparators.entry: unsigned H0 landscape-speed global maximum on the same search domain
comparators.exit: unsigned H1 landscape-speed global maximum on the same search domain
comparators.extra_negative_control: unsigned H0 landscape-speed global maximum interpreted as exit

guardrails: The physical selection is topology-blind but conditional and therefore does not validate an unconditional phase classifier.
No threshold or field window may be tuned after viewing these projections.
The PBC transfer keeps the OBC-clean template unchanged.
H2 and H3 are not computed.
